key_observations: Even with 2 of 4-6 nodes lost to timm env-gap, aggregator ensemble produces a perfect score from the surviving nodes.

Sonnet-coder is sufficient for aerial-cactus; opus is unnecessary but doesn't hurt.
Per-node routing's adaptive design carries over WITHOUT family override — the LLM router's cold read of the task data is enough.
